scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -w run build:web
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run build:web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('artifacts/mobile/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); console.log('Copied artifacts/mobile/dist to root dist');"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
